name: Mika Valenzuela

physical_description.heritage: Multiethnic diaspora blend: predominantly Hispanic/Latin American (37.5%) with significant Eastern European (21.6%), Middle Eastern (18.3%), Sub-Saharan African (11.9%), and East Asian (10.7%) ancestry. The combination produces a complexion and facial structure that defies singular regional categorization—a living example of the Ubiquitous Diaspora.
physical_description.build: Athletic and broad-shouldered with lean musculature; carries himself with the economical movement of someone used to confined spaces and quick exits
physical_description.hair_color: Dark brown with premature silver threading at temples
physical_description.hair_style: Closely cropped fade with defined lines, maintained weekly
physical_description.eye_color: Deep brown with slight amber undertone
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium complexion with subtle golden and olive undertones—the layered result of Latin American, Eastern European, Middle Eastern, Sub-Saharan, and East Asian heritage blending into a cohesive warm-tan hue that shifts in different lighting
physical_description.complexion: Sharp cheekbones with subtle width suggesting East Asian ancestry, strong defined jawline reflecting both Latin and Eastern European heritage. Facial structure carries the geometric precision common to Middle Eastern genetics. Five o'clock shadow is his default state. No facial hair beyond stubble. Small scar tissue above right eyebrow from old break. Skin shows the weathering of someone in his forties, though he's only 37—premature aging from stress and poor sleep cycles.
distinguishing_marks: Surgical scar running 8cm along right inner forearm, pale and old—consistent with augmentation removal or installation
Faded tattoo on left wrist: circuit board pattern in deep blue, partially covered by a newer overlay of Cyrillic characters (family name in his mother's script)
Burn scar across left knuckles, about 3cm across, from an acetylene torch accident in his twenties
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Reinforced knuckles with barely-perceptible subdermal plating visible as faint silver lines across his hands when light catches them. Faint neural interface scarring at base of skull—suggests subcutaneous array. No obvious chrome limbs or LED optics; he operates in a tier where subtlety keeps you alive.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with deliberate economy—never wasted motion. Tends to keep his hands visible and relaxed, a practiced tell of someone used to tense negotiations. Favors his left side slightly. Leans against walls rather than sitting; always positions himself with sightlines to exits.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 pragmatist. Favors dark-colored utility jackets from mid-tier manufacturers (Kessler, Vertex) with reinforced pockets and hidden compartments. Wears matte-black tactical pants with cargo thigh pockets. Steel-toed boots, scuffed and practical. A worn leather jacket over everything—old money, inherited piece that's been repaired more than once. No jewelry except a simple titanium ring on his right ring finger (no wedding band). Clothes smell faintly of machine oil and cold tobacco.
